method: 公开来源采集、历史去重、规则筛选与模型审阅

items.title: Pathway Modeling of Genomic and Tissue-Specific Transcriptomic Architecture Identifies Personalized Mechanisms of Atrial Fibrillation Risk
items.abstract_or_text: Atrial fibrillation (AF) is the most common sustained cardiac arrhythmia and a major cause of cardioembolic stroke. Although polygenic risk scores (PRS) are well characterized to quantify inherited susceptibility for AF, they provide limited insight into the pathways and tissues underlying genetic risk, which are critical to uncover for individual risk prediction. In this study, we develop a pathway-level multi-omics representation learning framework that converts individual genetic profiles into interpretable biological features by integrating GWAS-derived pathway burden scores with tissue-specific transcriptomic pathway signals. We constructed machine learning models to assess population-level AF risk prediction performance across genomic and transcriptomic tissue contexts; the pathway-based global attention models substantially improved risk prediction performance over PRS and other baselines (AUROC improved from 0.601 to 0.738). Transformer and graph neural network frameworks then assessed individual-level pathway interpretability, revealing heterogeneous contributions from electrical signaling, cardiac development, and DNA repair pathways to AF risk. This added interpretability highlights the potential of this pathway approach to enable more mechanistically informed risk stratification than static PRS by capturing underlying heterogeneity. To independently assess whether prioritized pathways reflected cardiac regulatory biology, we compared pathway rankings with transcriptional effects predicted by the AlphaGenome foundation model. Variants in highly ranked pathways showed significantly greater predicted effects on expression in atrial and ventricular tissues (FDR = 0.032) relative to controls, providing orthogonal evidence that the model identifies biologically relevant mechanisms. Overall, this work reframes polygenic risk from a single measure of susceptibility to tissue-informed pathway mechanisms, providing a framework for interpretable genomic stratification in complex diseases.
items.summary_zh: 通路级多组学表示学习解析心房颤动遗传风险的组织与生物学异质性。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 模型在风险预测中优于 PRS，并以组织特异的转录调控预测提供旁证；其结果适合用于研究性风险分层，尚不能证明特定通路导致心房颤动。
items.abstract_zh: 心房颤动（AF）是最常见的持续性心律失常，也是心源性栓塞性卒中的主要原因。尽管多基因风险评分（PRS）已被充分用于量化 AF 的遗传易感性，但它们对遗传风险所涉及的通路和组织提供的认识有限，而这些认识对个体风险预测至关重要。在本研究中，我们开发了一种通路层面的多组学表示学习框架，将 GWAS 衍生的通路负担评分与组织特异性转录组通路信号整合，把个体遗传谱转换为可解释的生物学特征。我们构建机器学习模型，在基因组与转录组组织背景下评估群体层面的 AF 风险预测表现；基于通路的全局注意力模型较 PRS 和其他基准显著提高了风险预测性能（AUROC 从 0.601 提高至 0.738）。随后，Transformer 和图神经网络框架评估个体层面的通路可解释性，揭示电信号传导、心脏发育和 DNA 修复通路对 AF 风险具有异质性贡献。这种额外的可解释性表明，该通路方法可通过捕获潜在异质性，实现比静态 PRS 更具机制信息的风险分层。为独立评估优先通路是否反映心脏调控生物学，我们将通路排序与 AlphaGenome 基础模型预测的转录效应进行了比较。与对照相比，高排序通路中的变异在心房和心室组织中显示出显著更大的预测表达效应（FDR = 0.032），为该模型识别具有生物学相关性机制提供了正交证据。总体而言，本工作将多基因风险从单一易感性指标重新表述为具有组织信息的通路机制，为复杂疾病的可解释基因组分层提供了框架。
items.author_line: Venkatesh, R., Deo, R., Cappola, T., Penn Medicine BioBank,, Ritchie, M. D., Kim, D.

items.title: Novel Large Language Model-Based Detection of Echocardiographic Markers of Right Ventricular Dysfunction
items.abstract_or_text: Background: Unstructured biomedical data, such as echocardiography reports, are rich in information but time consuming to analyze at scale. Rule-based, regular expression-driven terminology mapping can only extract individual variables while large language models (LLMs) offer scalable and clinically meaningful interpretations of heterogeneous disease processes. Right ventricular dysfunction (RVD) is an example of a multifactorial disease state in which key structural and physiologic features are captured both narratively and in structured fields, making it an ideal test case for evaluating whether LLMs can recover complex phenotypes that rules based methods routinely miss. Purpose: To compare an LLM-based extraction method to a conventional rules-based schema for identifying and phenotyping echocardiographic features associated with RVD in a large TTE dataset. Methods: MIMIC-III NOTE2NUM echocardiography reports (n = 45,794) were analyzed using GPT-4o-based LLM extraction deployed within a secure health system enclave and were benchmarked against echocardiographic measurements defined in the MIMIC-III dictionary schema. In MIMIC-III, PH was recorded qualitatively (mild/moderate/severe) based on tricuspid regurgitant (TR) jet velocity and then re-coded as present vs. absent. LLM based extraction defined RVD as (1) RV structural abnormality (>= 1 of hypertrophy, dilation, or wall hypo-/akinesis) or (2) RV pressure/volume overload (>= 2 of the following: estimated right atrial pressure > 8 mmHg, TR jet velocity > 2.8 m/s, fractional area change 14), with PH defined as estimated pulmonary artery systolic pressure > 35 mmHg or qualitative documentation of PH. Results: LLM extraction identified PH in 15,394 (33.6%), RV pressure/volume overload in 14,449 (31.6%), and RV structural abnormalities in 11,955 (26.1%). Co-occurrence was common: overload + structural changes in 9,380 (20.5%), overload + PH in 9,756 (21.3%), structural changes + PH in 6,183 (13.5%), and all three in 5,620 (12.3%). Using the MIMIC-III dictionary schema, PH prevalence was similar (15,371; 33.6%), but RV overload fields were captured less often (pressure overload 1,357 [3.0%], volume overload 1,128 [2.5%], pressure + volume overload 1,093 [2.4%]; any overload field 3,578 [7.8%]), and RV pressure/volume overload with PH was identified in only 731 (1.6%). Conclusions: LLM-based extraction outperforms rules-based schemas for identifying complex disease states not defined by any single variable. By synthesizing multifactorial signals, LLMs can phenotype RVD with higher fidelity and support population-level assessment. Further validation using multimodality imaging, invasive hemodynamics, and clinical outcome data is needed.
items.summary_zh: 在 45,794 份 MIMIC-III 超声心动图报告中，LLM 提取的右心室功能障碍表型多于规则系统。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作展示了 LLM 可从非结构化临床报告重建多因素表型；作者明确指出仍需影像、血流动力学及结局验证。
items.abstract_zh: 背景：非结构化生物医学数据，例如超声心动图报告，包含丰富信息，但难以大规模分析。基于规则和正则表达式的术语映射只能提取单个变量，而大语言模型（LLM）可对异质性疾病过程进行可扩展且具有临床意义的解读。右心室功能障碍（RVD）是一个多因素疾病状态，其关键结构和生理特征同时记录于叙述性文本和结构化字段，因此是检验 LLM 能否恢复规则方法经常遗漏的复杂表型的理想案例。目的：比较 LLM 提取法与常规规则架构在大型经胸超声心动图（TTE）数据集中识别和表型化 RVD 相关超声特征的能力。方法：使用部署在安全医疗系统隔离环境中的基于 GPT-4o 的 LLM 提取法，分析 MIMIC-III NOTE2NUM 的 45,794 份超声心动图报告，并以 MIMIC-III 字典架构中定义的超声测量值作为基准。在 MIMIC-III 中，肺动脉高压（PH）根据三尖瓣反流（TR）射流速度以轻度/中度/重度进行定性记录，随后重新编码为存在或不存在。LLM 提取将 RVD 定义为：（1）右心室结构异常（肥厚、扩张或室壁运动减弱/无运动中至少 1 项），或（2）右心室压力/容量负荷过重（以下至少 2 项：估计右心房压 > 8 mmHg、TR 射流速度 > 2.8 m/s、面积变化分数 14）；PH 定义为估计肺动脉收缩压 > 35 mmHg 或有 PH 的定性记录。结果：LLM 提取识别出 15,394 例（33.6%）PH、14,449 例（31.6%）右心室压力/容量负荷过重和 11,955 例（26.1%）右心室结构异常。共同出现十分常见：负荷过重加结构改变 9,380 例（20.5%）、负荷过重加 PH 9,756 例（21.3%）、结构改变加 PH 6,183 例（13.5%）、三者均有 5,620 例（12.3%）。使用 MIMIC-III 字典架构时，PH 患病率相近（15,371 例；33.6%），但右心室负荷过重字段的捕获明显较少（压力负荷过重 1,357 例［3.0%］、容量负荷过重 1,128 例［2.5%］、压力加容量负荷过重 1,093 例［2.4%］；任一负荷字段 3,578 例［7.8%］），且仅识别出 731 例（1.6%）同时存在右心室压力/容量负荷过重和 PH 的病例。结论：对于并非由任何单一变量定义的复杂疾病状态，基于 LLM 的提取优于基于规则的架构。通过综合多因素信号，LLM 可更高保真地表型化 RVD，并支持群体层面的评估。仍需要利用多模态影像、有创血流动力学和临床结局数据进一步验证。
items.author_line: Ekambarapu, L., Pendyal, A., Lin, A., Alwakeel, M., Rajaratnam, A.

items.title: Development and Optimization of 111In-Dinutuximab-IRDye800, a Dual-Modality Intraoperative Molecular Imaging Agent for Pediatric Neuroblastoma Resection
items.abstract_or_text: Rationale: Neuroblastoma is a devastating pediatric malignancy, for which surgical resection is a key factor in long-term survival. However, there are significant challenges in its resection, particularly in high-risk disease, as neuroblastoma encases surrounding critical structures, is often difficult to distinguish from desmoplastic or scar tissue, and can carry occult deposits of disease not readily identified on preoperative imaging or intraoperative visualization. Building on the principles of fluorescent and radio-guided surgery, in combination with the known overexpression of GD2 in neuroblastoma, we sought to develop and optimize 111In-Dinutuximab-IRDye800, a dual-modality GD2-targeted intraoperative molecular imaging agent, for use in pediatric neuroblastoma to help enhance patient safety while facilitating a more complete resection. Methods: Dinutuximab was conjugated to IRDye800 and DTPA, then radiolabeled with Indium-111 to yield 111In-Dinutuximab-IRDye800. Optimization occurred through ELISA assay to assess binding affinity, fluorescence intensity analysis to determine the optimal fluorescent degree of labeling, and phototoxicity testing through flow cytometry. Rodent models of neuroblastoma were then generated through injection of SK-N-BE(2) human neuroblastoma cells into the left adrenal glands of nude mice or RNU rats. A series of fluorescent and gamma biodistributions was performed, varying the dose, timing, and specific activity of the tracer. Tumor and organ uptake of the tracer was compared with one- or two-way ANOVA as appropriate, with Sidaks multiple comparison test to compare tumor uptake to individual organs. Once optimization was complete, a clinically significant events study modeled after human clinical trials was performed to evaluate the in vivo capabilities of 111In-Dinutuximab-IRDye800. Results: Increased ratios of IRDye800 per antibody led to decreased binding affinity for GD2 and was associated with formulation instability without significant return on fluorescence intensity. Specific activity of the tracer was not found to impact overall biodistribution of the tracer. A 45-50 microgram dose of 111In-Dinutuximab-IRDye800 with ratios around 1 DTPA and 1-1.5 IRDye800 per antibody imaged 4 days after tracer administration was found to be the optimal combination that maximized detectable tumor-specific signal. In the clinically significant events study mirroring human IMI clinical trials, fluorescent guidance identified additional malignant lesions not originally detected under white light in 64% of rodents. Conclusions: 111In-Dinutuximab-IRDye800 is a dual-modality GD2-targeted intraoperative imaging agent that is well-poised for clinical translation. As it preserves tumor specificity, yields clinically meaningful radiofluorescent signal, and is well-tolerated without adverse events after optimization was completed, it carries the potential to positively impact the safety and completeness of neuroblastoma resection.
items.summary_zh: GD2 靶向的 111In-Dinutuximab-IRDye800 在神经母细胞瘤啮齿动物模型中实现放射性与荧光双模术中成像。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 研究完成了示踪剂的结合、给药和体内成像优化，并在动物中发现白光下漏检的病灶；临床转化效益仍有待人体研究检验。
items.abstract_zh: 理论依据：神经母细胞瘤是一种严重的儿童恶性肿瘤，手术切除是长期生存的关键因素。然而，尤其在高危疾病中，其切除面临重大挑战：神经母细胞瘤可包绕周围关键结构，常难以与促纤维组织或瘢痕组织区分，并可能携带术前影像或术中肉眼观察不易发现的隐匿病灶。基于荧光和放射性引导手术原理，并结合 GD2 在神经母细胞瘤中的已知过表达，我们拟开发并优化 111In-Dinutuximab-IRDye800，一种 GD2 靶向双模术中分子成像剂，用于儿童神经母细胞瘤，以在促进更完整切除的同时提高患者安全性。方法：将 Dinutuximab 与 IRDye800 和 DTPA 偶联，再以 Indium-111 放射性标记，得到 111In-Dinutuximab-IRDye800。通过 ELISA 测定评估结合亲和力，通过荧光强度分析确定最佳荧光标记度，并通过流式细胞术进行光毒性测试。随后，通过向裸鼠或 RNU 大鼠左肾上腺注射人神经母细胞瘤 SK-N-BE(2) 细胞建立啮齿动物神经母细胞瘤模型。我们开展一系列荧光和伽马分布实验，改变示踪剂剂量、成像时机和比活度。采用适当的单因素或双因素 ANOVA 比较肿瘤和器官对示踪剂的摄取，并采用 Sidak 多重比较检验比较肿瘤摄取与各个器官摄取。优化完成后，我们进行了仿照人体临床试验的临床重要事件研究，以评估 111In-Dinutuximab-IRDye800 的体内能力。结果：每个抗体分子上 IRDye800 比例增加会降低对 GD2 的结合亲和力，并与制剂不稳定相关，而荧光强度没有显著收益。示踪剂比活度未影响总体生物分布。给药后第 4 天成像、111In-Dinutuximab-IRDye800 剂量为 45–50 microgram、每个抗体约含 1 个 DTPA 和 1–1.5 个 IRDye800 的组合，可最大化可检测的肿瘤特异性信号。在模拟人体 IMI 临床试验的临床重要事件研究中，荧光引导在 64% 的啮齿动物中识别出白光下最初未发现的额外恶性病灶。结论：111In-Dinutuximab-IRDye800 是一种 GD2 靶向双模术中成像剂，已具备良好的临床转化前景。优化完成后，该制剂保持肿瘤特异性，产生具有临床意义的放射荧光信号，并且耐受良好、未出现不良事件，因此有可能改善神经母细胞瘤切除的安全性和完整性。
items.author_line: Yip, C. Y., Rosenblum, L. T., Pant, A., Kahler-Quesada, A., Chagantipati, B., Sever, R., Grano-Mickelsen, B., Li, B., Cortez, A. G., Latoche, J. D., Day, K. E., Rigatti, L., Nedrow, J. R., Edwards, B. W., Kohanbash, G., Malek, M. M.

items.title: Trends in Machine Learning and Feature Selection Stability for Human Gut Microbiome (Shotgun Metagenomics) and Metabolomics Matched Datasets
items.abstract_or_text: Microbiome research is often limited by methodological inconsistencies that reduce reproducibility and functional insight. Traditional taxonomy-based profiling is limited by sparse data, variable resolution, and reliance on gDNA sequencing which provides only indirect links to microbial function. Multi-omics integration offers a framework for linking community composition to functional outputs, but progress has been hindered by the lack of standardized frameworks and inconsistent use of machine learning. In particular, feature selection stability, which is central to biomarker discovery and experimental validation, remains underexplored. Here, we systematically benchmarked three widely used algorithms (Elastic Net, Random Forest, XGBoost) across seven multi-omics integration strategies and single-omics models. Additionally, we evaluated the impact of transforming metabolomics and taxonomic abundance data. Using human gut microbiome datasets that integrate metagenomic taxonomic profiles with metabolomics, we evaluated models for 9 binary and 8 continuous outcomes across 20 train/test splits per dataset. We further assessed the effect of feature reduction on both predictive accuracy and feature selection stability. Nonlinear learners were most consistently competitive: continuous outcomes favored metabolomics-dominant models, whereas binary outcomes favored stacked multi-omics models. Random Forest and XGBoost also yielded greater feature selection stability, particularly for full dimensional metabolomics data. Together, these findings demonstrate how integration strategy, algorithm choice, and data preprocessing jointly shape predictive performance and feature selection reproducibility in multi-omics microbiome modeling.
items.summary_zh: 系统比较多组学整合策略及算法对肠道微生物组—代谢组预测和特征选择稳定性的影响。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 研究将准确率与可重复的特征选择并列评估，为多组学微生物组标志物研究提供了可复用的比较依据。
items.abstract_zh: 微生物组研究常受方法学不一致的限制，这会降低可重复性和功能解释。传统的基于分类学的分析受限于数据稀疏、分辨率可变以及依赖 gDNA 测序，后者仅能间接联系微生物功能。多组学整合为连接群落组成与功能输出提供了框架，但缺乏标准化框架以及机器学习使用不一致阻碍了进展。尤其是对生物标志物发现和实验验证至关重要的特征选择稳定性，仍缺乏充分研究。我们在 7 种多组学整合策略和单组学模型中，系统基准比较了三种常用算法（Elastic Net、Random Forest、XGBoost）。此外，我们评估了代谢组和分类丰度数据变换的影响。利用整合宏基因组分类学谱与代谢组的肠道微生物组数据集，我们对每个数据集进行 20 次训练/测试划分，评估模型对 9 个二分类结局和 8 个连续结局的表现。我们还评估了特征降维对预测准确度及特征选择稳定性的影响。非线性学习器的竞争力最为稳定：连续结局更适合以代谢组为主的模型，而二分类结局更适合堆叠式多组学模型。Random Forest 和 XGBoost 也产生了更高的特征选择稳定性，尤其是在全维度代谢组数据中。总体而言，这些发现表明，整合策略、算法选择和数据预处理共同塑造多组学微生物组建模中的预测表现与特征选择可重复性。
items.author_line: Palmer, S. N., Mishra, A. A., Zarek, C. M., Gan, S., Wang, R., Kim, J., Liu, D., Koh, A., Zhan, X.

items.title: Decoding heterogeneous aging clocks and disease risk stratification using MetAgeFormer
items.abstract_or_text: Metabolomic aging clocks estimate biological age by modeling metabolite concentrations, thereby capturing aging signals from healthspan and adverse outcomes. However, existing clocks generally assume homogeneous aging trajectories and yield only a single age acceleration metric, limiting their capacity to capture inter-individual metabolic heterogeneity and characterize nuanced individual-level representations. To address these limitations, we proposed MetAgeFormer, a transformer-based metabolomic model pre-trained on nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) metabolomic profiles from over 430,000 participants in UK Biobank via self-supervised learning. This large-scale pre-training enables MetAgeFormer to learn a metabolomic representation space that captures the complex, nonlinear structure of systemic metabolism as reflected in NMR data. Building on MetAgeFormer, we developed a mortality-informed metabolomic aging clock by fine-tuning an attached survival module, deriving age acceleration that demonstrates significant associations with multiple age-related diseases and factors. We further validated zero-shot transfer in the independent Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative (ADNI) cohort. More importantly, we utilized embeddings generated by MetAgeFormer to identify 13 distinct metabolic subtypes and consolidated them into four meta-subtypes with markedly divergent susceptibility profiles for major age-related diseases, particularly type 2 diabetes and neurodegenerative disorders. This finding empirically demonstrated substantial metabolic heterogeneity across populations, persisting even at comparable levels of age acceleration. To enhance clinical applicability, we further employed contrastive learning to distill a lightweight model that approximates the learned metabolomic representation space using only 14 routine clinical blood test measurements as inputs. Both hold-out testing within UK Biobank and external validation in the China Health and Retirement Longitudinal Study replicated similar disease onset patterns across the identified subtypes, underscoring the robust generalizability of MetAgeFormer and supporting its translational potential as a scalable framework for metabolomic aging assessment and early disease risk stratification.
items.summary_zh: MetAgeFormer 在超过 430,000 名 UK Biobank 参与者的 NMR 代谢组数据上预训练，用于刻画异质性衰老。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 超大规模预训练、ADNI 与 CHARLS 验证，以及由 14 项常规血检近似的轻量模型，使代谢组风险分型更具可检验性。
items.abstract_zh: 代谢组衰老时钟通过建模代谢物浓度估计生物学年龄，因此可捕获与健康寿命和不良结局相关的衰老信号。然而，现有时钟通常假定衰老轨迹同质，只给出单一的年龄加速指标，限制了其捕获个体间代谢异质性和表征细致个体特征的能力。为解决这些限制，我们提出 MetAgeFormer：一种基于 Transformer 的代谢组模型，使用 UK Biobank 中超过 430,000 名参与者的核磁共振（NMR）代谢组谱进行自监督预训练。这种大规模预训练使 MetAgeFormer 能够学习一个代谢组表示空间，捕捉 NMR 数据所反映的系统代谢复杂非线性结构。在 MetAgeFormer 基础上，我们通过微调附加的生存模块开发了一个以死亡率为信息的代谢组衰老时钟，得到的年龄加速与多种年龄相关疾病和因素显著相关。我们还在独立的阿尔茨海默病神经影像学计划（ADNI）队列中验证了零样本迁移。更重要的是，我们利用 MetAgeFormer 生成的嵌入识别出 13 个不同的代谢亚型，并将其归并为 4 个元亚型；这些元亚型对主要年龄相关疾病，尤其是 2 型糖尿病和神经退行性疾病，呈现显著不同的易感性谱。该发现经验性表明，即使在相当的年龄加速水平下，人群之间仍存在显著的代谢异质性。为提高临床适用性，我们进一步采用对比学习蒸馏出一个轻量模型，仅以 14 项常规临床血液检测指标为输入，近似学习到的代谢组表示空间。在 UK Biobank 留出测试和中国健康与养老追踪调查（CHARLS）的外部验证中，均复现了所识别亚型相似的疾病发生模式，表明 MetAgeFormer 具有稳健的泛化能力，并支持其作为可扩展代谢组衰老评估和早期疾病风险分层框架的转化潜力。
items.author_line: Xu, Y., Zou, B., Xie, G., Chen, T., Jia, W., Zhang, L.

items.title: Primary Care Quality and Inappropriate Community Antibiotic Use: A Double Machine Learning Instrumental Variable Approach
items.abstract_or_text: Inappropriate antibiotic use presents a major global health challenge, particularly in low-resource settings where access to quality care is limited but antibiotics remain relatively unrestricted. This study estimates the causal effect of frontline primary care quality on inappropriate community antibiotic use, combining detailed community-based data from approximately 100 rural villages in rural China with an instrumental variable (IV) approach embedded within a double/debiased machine learning (DML) framework. We linked objective measures of village doctor clinical practice quality, measured through unannounced standardized patient visits, to household-level antibiotic use data collected from the same villages. To identify the causal effect, we constructed multiple candidate instruments from extensive provider characteristics and used an ensemble of machine learning algorithms within a flexible DML-IV framework to approximate an optimal instrument, addressing a many-weak-instruments problem. We found that improving village provider clinical practice quality reduced both antibiotic receipt during healthcare encounters for common diseases and household antibiotic storage for future self-medication. Our findings suggest that strengthening frontline primary care quality can meaningfully reduce inappropriate community antibiotic use without restricting access to essential treatment. More broadly, this study illustrates how causal machine learning can strengthen conventional causal estimation in complex observational settings in global health economics research.
items.summary_zh: 双重机器学习工具变量分析关联中国农村基层诊疗质量与不当社区抗生素使用的减少。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 研究采用标准化病人测得的诊疗质量与机器学习工具变量估计，强化了观察性资料中的因果识别；结果仍依赖工具变量假设。
items.abstract_zh: 不当抗生素使用是一项重大的全球健康挑战，尤其是在优质医疗服务可及性有限、但抗生素相对不受限制的低资源环境中。本研究估计一线基层医疗质量对不当社区抗生素使用的因果效应，将中国农村约 100 个村庄的详尽社区资料与嵌入双重/去偏机器学习（DML）框架的工具变量（IV）方法结合。我们将通过非预告标准化病人就诊测量的村医临床实践质量，与在相同村庄收集的家庭层面抗生素使用资料相联系。为识别因果效应，我们从大量医疗提供者特征中构建多个候选工具变量，并在灵活的 DML-IV 框架内使用机器学习算法集成，以近似最优工具变量，从而处理多个弱工具变量问题。我们发现，提高村级医疗提供者的临床实践质量可减少常见疾病就诊时获得抗生素的情况，也减少家庭储存抗生素以备日后自行用药的情况。我们的发现表明，加强一线基层医疗质量可在不限制必要治疗可及性的情况下，有意义地减少不当社区抗生素使用。更广泛地说，本研究说明因果机器学习能够在全球卫生经济学研究复杂观察性资料中强化传统因果估计。
items.author_line: Chen, Y., Yi, H., Rao, S., Weber, A., Hassmiller-Lich, K., Sylvia, S.

items.title: Machine Learning-Based Prediction of Maternal Morbidity across Heterogeneous Populations in the United States using Sequential Modeling of the All of Us Dataset
items.abstract_or_text: In this work, we demonstrate the unprecedented value of NIH's "All of Us Research Program" (AoURP) dataset in studying maternal morbidity and building predictive machine learning (ML) models across heterogeneous populations in the United States. We developed robust and data-driven preprocessing pipelines to curate a longitudinal, multi-site, multimodal, and demographically diverse pregnancy dataset (20,253 subjects; 27,525 pregnancy episodes) from AoURP data, using electronic health records (EHR) (Conditions, Labs, Measurements) and survey responses (Social Determinant of Health (SDoH)), focusing on 7 crucial maternal health adverse outcomes. After characterizing data quality, missingness, and heterogeneity, we performed statistical correlation analysis to identify risk factors. We subsequently developed XGBoost and sequential LSTM models to predict the adverse outcomes, reaching state-of-the-art performance for multiple outcomes. We conducted model interpretability post-hoc analysis to understand success points and fairness analysis to evaluate implications for socio-economic disparities. Four practicing physicians reviewed the set of statistically significant and ML model identified features to assess their clinical validity and novelty. Most features identified through either statistical correlations or ML feature importance analysis aligned with known clinical risk factors. Several features were identified that the ML models used but that are not currently used in clinical practice and may merit further clinical investigation. Fairness analysis revealed certain associations with SDoH and age highlight areas that warrant continued monitoring. Overall, we demonstrate that meaningful populational level patterns can be extracted, and high-performing machine learning models can be trained on this longitudinal, diverse, multi-site dataset. Important risk features, particularly novel ones identified, if validated, could inform new strategies for maternal care or enable development and validation of outcome-specific, clinically deployable ML models.
items.summary_zh: 基于 All of Us 的 20,253 名受试者、27,525 次妊娠建立多模态母体不良结局预测模型。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 多中心纵向队列、临床医生审阅和公平性分析扩大了证据基础；模型发现的风险特征仍须独立验证后方可用于临床。
items.abstract_zh: 在本工作中，我们展示了 NIH 的“全民研究计划”（All of Us Research Program，AoURP）数据集在研究美国异质人群母体患病率及构建预测性机器学习（ML）模型方面前所未有的价值。我们开发了稳健且数据驱动的预处理流程，从 AoURP 数据中整理出纵向、多中心、多模态且人口学多样的妊娠数据集（20,253 名受试者；27,525 次妊娠），使用电子健康记录（EHR）的疾病、实验室和测量资料，以及社会健康决定因素（SDoH）问卷回答，聚焦 7 种关键母体健康不良结局。在表征资料质量、缺失情况和异质性后，我们进行统计相关性分析以识别风险因素。随后，我们开发 XGBoost 和序列 LSTM 模型预测这些不良结局，在多个结局上达到当前最佳表现。我们进行了模型事后可解释性分析，以理解成功因素，并进行了公平性分析，以评估社会经济差异的影响。4 名执业医师审阅了统计学显著和 ML 模型识别出的特征集，以评估其临床有效性和新颖性。通过统计相关性或 ML 特征重要性识别出的多数特征与已知临床风险因素一致。ML 使用但当前临床实践中尚未使用的若干特征，可能值得进一步临床研究。公平性分析显示，SDoH 和年龄的一些关联值得持续监测。总体而言，我们证明可以从这一纵向、多样化、多中心数据集中提取具有意义的人群层面模式，并训练高性能机器学习模型。重要风险特征，尤其是新识别的特征，如获验证，可能为母体照护提供新策略，或支持开发和验证可临床部署的、结局特异模型。
items.author_line: Zhuang, H., Zakama, A., Heller, K., Faulkner, S., Gollub, B., Young-Lin, N., Chen, I. Y., Asiedu, M.

items.title: Clinically Generalisable End-to-End Graph Learning for CT Image-Based Multitask Stroke Diagnosis
items.abstract_or_text: Stroke remains a leading cause of mortality and long-term disability worldwide, yet rapid diagnosis is often limited by the shortage of trained radiologists, particularly in resource-constrained settings. Automated analysis of CT imaging offers a potential solution, but existing methods often struggle to achieve clinically generalisable performance while jointly addressing multiple diagnostic tasks. Here we present the Intelligent Integrated Stroke Diagnosis System IISDS, an end-to-end deep learning framework built upon StrokeGNN, a graph-based architecture that integrates 3D contextual feature extraction with U-Net-based 2D lesion segmentation to enable comprehensive stroke analysis from non-contrast CT scans. IISDS performs stroke subtype classification, lesion segmentation and lesion volume estimation within a unified pipeline. To develop and validate the system, we collected and curated BGD-ISD through a collaboration between AI researchers, neurologists, radiologists and clinicians, resulting in a large multi-centre dataset comprising 1,507 CT scans from 597 stroke cases acquired across six hospitals and medical centres in Bangladesh. Across BGD-ISD and multiple publicly available datasets, IISDS achieves state-of-the-art performance on all tasks, improving segmentation accuracy by [≥]0.011 Dice score, reducing lesion volume estimation error by [≥]0.3 average symmetric surface distance (ASSD), and increasing classification performance by [≥]0.018 area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) compared with existing approaches. These results demonstrate the potential of graph-based deep learning to enable clinically generalisable, automated and scalable stroke diagnosis from CT imaging, supporting rapid clinical decision-making, particularly in healthcare environments with limited access to expert radiological interpretation.
items.summary_zh: IISDS 以图学习整合非增强 CT 的卒中分型、病灶分割与体积估计，并在孟加拉国多中心资料中评估。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 统一多任务流程结合 6 家机构的 1,507 次 CT 与公开数据集测试，适合资源有限场景的研究性辅助诊断探索。
items.abstract_zh: 卒中仍是全球死亡和长期残疾的主要原因，但快速诊断常受训练有素放射科医师短缺的限制，资源受限环境尤其如此。CT 影像的自动分析提供了潜在解决方案，但现有方法通常难以在同时处理多个诊断任务时取得可临床泛化的表现。本文提出智能整合卒中诊断系统 IISDS：一个构建于 StrokeGNN 的端到端深度学习框架。该图架构整合三维上下文特征提取和基于 U-Net 的二维病灶分割，从非增强 CT 扫描实现全面卒中分析。IISDS 在统一流程内完成卒中亚型分类、病灶分割和病灶体积估计。为开发和验证该系统，我们通过 AI 研究者、神经科医师、放射科医师和临床医师合作，收集并整理 BGD-ISD，形成来自孟加拉国 6 家医院和医疗中心的 597 例卒中病例、1,507 次 CT 扫描的大型多中心数据集。在 BGD-ISD 和多个公开数据集上，IISDS 在所有任务中均达到当前最佳表现：相较现有方法，分割准确度提高 [≥]0.011 Dice 分数，病灶体积估计误差降低 [≥]0.3 平均对称表面距离（ASSD），分类表现提高 [≥]0.018 ROC 曲线下面积（AUC）。这些结果显示，基于图的深度学习有望实现可临床泛化、自动化且可扩展的 CT 卒中诊断，支持快速临床决策，尤其适用于缺乏专业放射影像解读资源的医疗环境。

items.title: Glioblastoma Tumors with Decelerated Epigenetic Aging Are Characterized by Glutamatergic Neuronal Activity and Stemness
items.abstract_or_text: Introduction: Gliomas integrate into neural circuits and heighten neuronal excitability, engaging in bidirectional communication whereby neuronal activity promotes tumor growth and proliferation. Aging reshapes the brain microenvironment through extracellular matrix changes, altered secretory factors, and immune dysfunction, creating conditions permissive to tumorigenesis and limiting immunotherapy efficacy in glioblastoma. However, its effect on neuronal excitability and signaling in glioblastoma remains poorly understood. Methods: We developed a novel classification system for glioblastoma by leveraging three classes of DNA methylation-based aging biomarkers: chronological, biological, and mitotic clocks. This approach stratified tumors into accelerated and decelerated epigenetic aging subtypes, which we then characterized at the molecular, functional, and clinical levels using multimodal analyses. Guided by these profiles, we evaluated the in vitro effects of the FDA-approved agents levetiracetam and riluzole, alone and in combination with temozolomide, on U87MG and A172 cell lines. Specifically, we assessed changes in cell viability, apoptosis, and the expression of marker genes related to stemness, neuronal hyperexcitability, and immunosuppression. Results: Tumors with decelerated epigenetic aging showed expression modules and CpG hypomethylation associated with neuronal activity and stemness, and carried significantly worse prognosis. Single-cell and spatial multi-omics analyses revealed enrichment for neurons and malignant neural stem-like cells in these tumors. They also displayed enhanced intercellular communication, driven predominantly by glutamate signaling across the malignant, neuronal, and immune compartments of the tumor microenvironment. In vitro pharmacological inhibition of glutamatergic signaling with levetiracetam and riluzole reduced cell viability, induced apoptosis, and suppressed expression of stemness, neuronal hyperexcitability, and immunosuppression markers. Both agents potentiated the cytotoxic and apoptotic effects of temozolomide, supporting glutamatergic inhibition as a strategy for improving chemosensitivity. Conclusion: By establishing a framework for decoding glioblastoma heterogeneity through epigenetic aging, we identified the glutamatergic pathway as a clinically actionable vulnerability. Our findings suggest that combining anti-glutamatergic therapies with temozolomide exerts synergistic antitumor effects while mitigating adverse chemotherapy-induced phenotypes, such as increased stemness, neuronal hyperexcitability, and immunosuppression, thereby laying the groundwork for novel therapeutic strategies.
items.summary_zh: 以 DNA 甲基化衰老时钟定义胶质母细胞瘤亚型，并结合单细胞、空间多组学和细胞实验考察谷氨酸信号。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 多模态资料将表观遗传衰老、神经元样状态和药物细胞实验联系起来；药物联合结论目前仅来自 U87MG 与 A172 体外模型。
items.abstract_zh: 引言：胶质瘤可整合进神经回路并增强神经元兴奋性，形成神经元活动促进肿瘤生长和增殖的双向交流。衰老通过细胞外基质改变、分泌因子变化和免疫功能障碍重塑脑微环境，形成有利于肿瘤发生并限制胶质母细胞瘤免疫治疗疗效的条件。然而，衰老对胶质母细胞瘤神经元兴奋性和信号传导的影响仍知之甚少。方法：我们利用三类基于 DNA 甲基化的衰老生物标志物，即时间年龄、生物学年龄和有丝分裂时钟，开发了一种新型胶质母细胞瘤分类系统。该方法将肿瘤分为表观遗传衰老加速和减速亚型，随后使用多模态分析从分子、功能和临床层面进行表征。在这些谱的指导下，我们在 U87MG 和 A172 细胞系中评估 FDA 批准药物 levetiracetam 和 riluzole 单用及与 temozolomide 联用的体外效应。具体而言，我们评估了细胞活力、凋亡以及与干性、神经元过度兴奋和免疫抑制相关标志基因表达的变化。结果：表观遗传衰老减速的肿瘤显示与神经元活动和干性相关的表达模块及 CpG 低甲基化，并具有显著更差的预后。单细胞和空间多组学分析显示，这些肿瘤中神经元和恶性神经干细胞样细胞富集。它们还表现出增强的细胞间通讯，主要由肿瘤微环境中恶性、神经元和免疫区室之间的谷氨酸信号驱动。使用 levetiracetam 和 riluzole 对谷氨酸信号进行体外药理抑制，降低了细胞活力，诱导凋亡，并抑制干性、神经元过度兴奋和免疫抑制标志物的表达。两种药物均增强了 temozolomide 的细胞毒性和促凋亡效应，支持抑制谷氨酸信号作为改善化疗敏感性的策略。结论：通过建立经由表观遗传衰老解读胶质母细胞瘤异质性的框架，我们识别出谷氨酸通路这一具有临床可操作性的脆弱点。我们的发现提示，抗谷氨酸治疗与 temozolomide 联用可产生协同抗肿瘤效应，同时减轻化疗诱导的不良表型，例如干性增强、神经元过度兴奋和免疫抑制，为新治疗策略奠定基础。
items.author_line: Motevasseli, M., Eterafi, M., Alaei, H., Zandi, P., Shajari, N., Tabrzi, M., Safarzadeh, E.

items.title: Prospective In-silico Simulation of the VESALIUS-CV Trial Using Biomedical Knowledge Graph and Real-World Data-Driven AI Modeling
items.abstract_or_text: Background. Cardiovascular-outcomes trials are lengthy, costly, and associated with substantial uncertainty prior to readout. In-silico trial simulation using real-world data (RWD) has emerged as a potential tool to support earlier decision-making; however, evidence of prospective predictive validity, generated prior to trial result disclosure, remains limited. Methods. We applied a semi-mechanistic machine learning framework integrating real-world patient data with biologically informed drug representations to prospectively simulate the VESALIUS-CV trial evaluating evolocumab versus placebo. The simulation model was trained on a combination of patient-level real-world data and a drug-centric knowledge graph and validated for both patient-level and trial-level retrospective predictive performance. The model was then used to simulate VESALIUS-CV before public disclosure of trial results, using a locked model and prespecified eligibility criteria and primary endpoint aligned with the clinical protocol. A patient-level time-to-event model was used to generate virtual trial arms, from which cumulative incidence curves, hazard ratios, confidence intervals, and p-values for major adverse cardiovascular events (MACE) were estimated. Results. In retrospective validation, the model demonstrated strong patient-level discrimination, with time-dependent ROC-AUC values ranging from 0.80 to 0.90 across follow-up horizons. For trial-level validation, 22 randomized cardiovascular-outcomes trials were simulated, and hazard ratios for 3-point MACE across 24 between-arm comparisons showed consistent directional agreement and quantitative correlation with published results such that the model accurately predicted trial success, achieving an F1 score of 0.83, with precision of 0.79 and sensitivity of 0.89. In a fully prospective application, the simulation predicted a statistically significant reduction in 3-point MACE with evolocumab versus placebo, estimating a hazard ratio of 0.78 (95% CI, 0.70-0.87) at 54 months. These predictions were consistent with the subsequently reported VESALIUS-CV results, which demonstrated a hazard ratio of 0.75 (95% CI, 0.65-0.86) at 55 months of median follow-up. Conclusions. In a fully prospective setting, a RWD-driven, AI-based simulation accurately predicted the direction, magnitude, and temporal dynamics of treatment effects observed in the VESALIUS-CV trial. These results demonstrate that in-silico trial simulation can anticipate clinical outcomes in the prospective setting, supporting its use as a complementary tool for early decision-making, trial design optimization, and de-risking in cardiovascular drug development.
items.summary_zh: 真实世界资料与药物知识图谱驱动的模型，在试验结果公布前模拟 VESALIUS-CV 并接近随后报告的治疗效应。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 研究报告了 22 项心血管结局试验的回顾性检验和一次预先设定的前瞻性模拟，为 AI 辅助试验设计提供了较强但仍需独立复现的证据。
items.abstract_zh: 背景：心血管结局试验耗时长、成本高，且在结果公布前存在很大不确定性。利用真实世界资料（RWD）的计算机试验模拟已成为支持更早决策的潜在工具；然而，在试验结果公开前形成的前瞻性预测效度证据仍然有限。方法：我们采用半机制机器学习框架，整合真实世界患者资料与具有生物学信息的药物表示，在前瞻性条件下模拟比较 evolocumab 与安慰剂的 VESALIUS-CV 试验。该模拟模型使用患者层面的真实世界资料与以药物为中心的知识图谱联合训练，并针对患者层面和试验层面的回顾性预测表现进行验证。随后，在试验结果公开前，使用锁定模型、预先规定的入选标准和与临床方案一致的主要终点模拟 VESALIUS-CV。采用患者层面生存时间模型生成虚拟试验组，并据此估计主要不良心血管事件（MACE）的累积发生曲线、风险比、置信区间和 p 值。结果：在回顾性验证中，模型在各随访时间范围的时间依赖 ROC-AUC 为 0.80–0.90，表现出较强的患者层面区分能力。对于试验层面验证，我们模拟了 22 项随机心血管结局试验；在 24 个组间比较中，3 点 MACE 的风险比与已发表结果在方向上持续一致、在数值上相关，模型能够准确预测试验成功，F1 分数为 0.83，精确率为 0.79，敏感度为 0.89。在完全前瞻性的应用中，该模拟预测 evolocumab 相较安慰剂可显著降低 3 点 MACE，在 54 个月时估计风险比为 0.78（95% CI，0.70–0.87）。这些预测与随后报告的 VESALIUS-CV 结果一致；后者在中位随访 55 个月时报告风险比为 0.75（95% CI，0.65–0.86）。结论：在完全前瞻性场景中，基于 RWD 的 AI 模拟准确预测了 VESALIUS-CV 试验所观察到的治疗效应方向、幅度和时间动态。这些结果表明，计算机试验模拟可在前瞻性情形下预期临床结局，支持其作为早期决策、试验设计优化和降低心血管药物开发不确定性的补充工具。
items.author_line: Perlman, A., Goldstein, N., Goldman, M., Shapiro, M., Barash, E., Bar, A., Raveh, T., Tordjman, E., Schussheim, H., Dormont, F., Matalon, O.

items.title: A self-supervised DNA foundation model with collapse-resistant multimodal fusion
items.abstract_or_text: Genomic foundation models pretrained on DNA sequence have achieved strong performance across many tasks, but sequence-only representations cannot fully capture regulatory information from additional DNA-centric modalities. Existing multimodal genomic models are optimized for specific prediction tasks rather than reusable embeddings. Directly fusing heterogeneous modalities is challenging because sparse, peak-shaped regulatory signals and dense sequence embeddings have markedly different statistical structures, making naive alignment prone to near-zero solutions. We present a self-supervised DNA-centric multimodal foundation model integrating DNA sequence embeddings with local and global chromatin accessibility in a shared encoder to produce reusable window-level embeddings. We show that global normalization alleviates this collapse, enabling effective joint learning. The resulting embeddings improve regulatory activity prediction, regulatory signal ranking and chromatin accessibility peak detection, achieving a 4.6-fold AUPRC improvement over the DNA-only baseline, with further gains on external ClinVar, GTEx eQTL and PBMC caQTL datasets.
items.summary_zh: 自监督 DNA 多模态基础模型将序列嵌入与局部、全局染色质可及性融合，以生成可复用窗口表示。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 模型针对多模态训练的表示塌缩提出全局归一化，并在 ClinVar、GTEx eQTL 与 PBMC caQTL 等外部资料中报告增益。
items.abstract_zh: 在 DNA 序列上预训练的基因组基础模型已在许多任务中取得强劲表现，但仅使用序列的表示无法充分捕获额外 DNA 中心模态中的调控信息。现有多模态基因组模型针对特定预测任务优化，而非生成可复用嵌入。直接融合异质模态具有挑战：稀疏、峰状调控信号与稠密序列嵌入具有明显不同的统计结构，使朴素对齐容易产生近零解。我们提出一个自监督、以 DNA 为中心的多模态基础模型，在共享编码器中整合 DNA 序列嵌入以及局部和全局染色质可及性，生成可复用的窗口层面嵌入。我们显示全局归一化可缓解这种塌缩，使有效联合学习成为可能。所得嵌入提高了调控活性预测、调控信号排序和染色质可及性峰检测的表现，相较仅使用 DNA 的基准，AUPRC 提高 4.6 倍，并在外部 ClinVar、GTEx eQTL 和 PBMC caQTL 数据集上获得进一步提升。

items.title: Cross-species single cell transcriptomics in fly and beetle reveals the genetic core of brain neuroblast specification
items.abstract_or_text: The brain is essential for animal survival and based on its conserved Bauplan, an impressive adaptive diversity has evolved. However, the genetic mechanisms regulating brain development and diversification remain enigmatic. The insect neural stem cells (neuroblasts, NBs) acquire different identities through the combinatorial expression of transcription factors (TFs), but this code is unknown for the brain. Here, we define the conserved core of TFs expressed in insect brain NBs by a combined analysis of single-cell expression from NBs derived from two holometabolous insects, the fly Drosophila melanogaster and the beetle Tribolium castaneum. In Tribolium, we established a Gal4 enhancer trap system to identify a line that marks NBs. From 37,137 sequenced NBs, we identified 10,425 brain NBs. In Drosophila, we sequenced 32,112 NB nuclei, identifying 12,389 brain NBs. Analysing the combined dataset strongly increased the sensitivity in specifying the core of 188 brain-specific TFs. We found two atypical clusters with some similarity to Type II NBs and identified seven transcription factors not previously associated with or confirmed in NBs (Hmx, CG15696, CG32532, dmrt99B, fD59A, TfAP-2, and Fer1). Our data reveals fundamental differences between brain and ventral nerve cord specification and paves the way to study the development and evolution of brain specific structures.
items.summary_zh: 跨果蝇与赤拟谷盗的单细胞转录组分析界定昆虫脑神经母细胞的保守转录因子核心。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 69,249 个测序神经母细胞及跨物种整合提高了脑特异转录因子检出能力，并补充了 7 个此前未确认的候选因子。
items.abstract_zh: 大脑对动物生存至关重要；在其保守的体制基础上，已演化出令人印象深刻的适应性多样性。然而，调控脑发育和多样化的遗传机制仍不清楚。昆虫神经干细胞，即神经母细胞（NB），通过转录因子（TF）的组合表达获得不同身份，但大脑中的这一编码尚未知晓。本文通过联合分析两种完全变态昆虫——果蝇 Drosophila melanogaster 和赤拟谷盗 Tribolium castaneum——来源 NB 的单细胞表达，界定昆虫脑 NB 中表达的保守 TF 核心。在 Tribolium 中，我们建立了 Gal4 增强子捕获系统，鉴定出一条标记 NB 的品系。在 37,137 个测序 NB 中，我们识别出 10,425 个脑 NB。在 Drosophila 中，我们对 32,112 个 NB 细胞核进行测序，识别出 12,389 个脑 NB。联合数据集的分析显著提高了确定 188 个脑特异性 TF 核心的敏感度。我们发现两个与 II 型 NB 有一定相似性的非典型簇，并识别出 7 个此前未与 NB 关联或未在 NB 中得到确认的转录因子（Hmx、CG15696、CG32532、dmrt99B、fD59A、TfAP-2 和 Fer1）。我们的数据揭示脑与腹神经索特化之间的基础差异，并为研究脑特异结构的发育和演化铺平道路。
items.author_line: Cabanas, N., Veloso, A., Zinzen, R., Bucher, G.

items.title: Corpusome, a cross-body-site human microbiome corpus for representation learning
items.abstract_or_text: Machine-learning models of the human microbiome are trained mostly on stool samples from single cohorts, limiting cross-body-site representation and cross-study generalization. Progress is constrained less by algorithms than by the absence of a harmonized multi-body-site corpus carrying the technical metadata needed to model, rather than ignore, batch structure. Here we release Corpusome, a harmonized two-tier cross-body-site human microbiome corpus for representation learning: a harmonized corpus of 187,546 human microbiome samples integrating standardized profiles from curatedMetagenomicData, the American Gut Project, and the EBI MGnify platform. Corpusome follows a two-tier design preserving both functional depth and cross-body-site breadth: a shotgun tier (22,588 samples, 93 studies) with species- and pathway-level profiles, and a 16S tier (164,958 samples, from a full pull of 708 MGnify studies) with genus-level profiles extending coverage to oral, skin, respiratory, and urogenital sites. It spans six body sites and two modalities, with harmonized metadata for batch-aware modelling. Body-site signal exceeds technical/source variance in the 16S tier by approximately 2.4-fold.
items.summary_zh: Corpusome 发布覆盖六个人体部位的 187,546 份微生物组样本语料库，支持批次感知的表征学习。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该资源将 shotgun 与 16S 数据及技术元数据协调整合，扩大了跨部位、跨研究的微生物组模型训练基础。
items.abstract_zh: 人类微生物组的机器学习模型大多在单一队列的粪便样本上训练，限制了跨身体部位表征和跨研究泛化。进展受算法限制的程度小于受协调化多身体部位语料库缺失的限制；后者需要携带技术元数据，以便建模而非忽略批次结构。本文发布 Corpusome：一个用于表征学习的协调化双层跨身体部位人类微生物组语料库。该协调化语料库整合 curatedMetagenomicData、American Gut Project 和 EBI MGnify 平台的标准化谱，包含 187,546 份人类微生物组样本。Corpusome 采用双层设计，同时保留功能深度和跨身体部位广度：shotgun 层包含 22,588 份样本、93 项研究，提供物种和通路层面的谱；16S 层包含 164,958 份样本，来自对 708 项 MGnify 研究的完整提取，提供属水平谱，并将覆盖范围扩展至口腔、皮肤、呼吸道和泌尿生殖道部位。它跨越 6 个身体部位和 2 种模态，并提供用于批次感知建模的协调化元数据。在 16S 层中，身体部位信号约为技术/来源方差的 2.4 倍。
